title: Warning: Two Unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation
summary: Two new unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances that allow remote code execution are being actively exploited in the wild, security firm watchTowr said on September 26.
card_summary: Two new unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances that allow remote code execution are being actively exploited in the wild, security firm watchTowr said on September 26.

sections.context: This story is part of the recurring zero-day pattern where exploitation pressure is highest before broad patch adoption.
